title: @bsh/degent-atelier environment
description: Environment variables read by src/config.ts. Secrets (marked x-secret) come from the secret store, never from the repo. With no provider key the service runs in `fake` mode (procedural placeholder art) and reports it in GET /v1/health. A live provider requires DATABASE_PATH + CONTENT_DIR so the cost ledger survives restarts.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Absolute base for previewUrl / downloadUrl in responses, e.g. https://atelier.degent.club. Empty = relative paths.

ATELIER_MODE.description: Provider selection. Default: openai if OPENAI_API_KEY is set, else http if HTTP_PROVIDER_URL is set, else fake. Set fake explicitly to force demo mode.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI Images key. Only ever sent in the Authorization header; never logged.

OPENAI_FALLBACK_MODEL.description: Used only when the primary model is unavailable to the key (404 / model_not_found / org not verified). 'none' disables.

PROVIDER_COST_CENTS_PER_IMAGE.description: Override the per-image cost estimate charged to the ledger (US cents). Defaults: OpenAI low 2 / medium 5 / high 17; HTTP 4; fake 0.

VISION_REVIEW_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key. Enables the optional Claude vision review of candidates and final bytes. Unset = rules review only.

DATABASE_PATH.description: node:sqlite file for sessions and the cost ledger. Unset (with CONTENT_DIR unset) = in-memory, fake mode only.

CONTENT_DIR.description: Content-addressed blob directory (<dir>/<aa>/<sha256>): provider sources, previews, finalised JPEGs.

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated exact origins (e.g. https://degent.club). Empty = deny all browser origins.

TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Comma-separated CIDRs of reverse proxies we run. X-Forwarded-For is honoured only from these peers.

RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: Requests per client IP per minute (token bucket).

SESSION_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: Generate / finalize / upload calls per session per minute.

SESSION_DAILY_IMAGES.description: Images one session may generate per UTC day (each variation counts).

GLOBAL_DAILY_COST_CENTS.description: Global provider spend cap per UTC day, US cents. Reserved before each provider call; 0 stops paid generation.
